The int a hop gets back cannot reveal a wrap ('10'+Long.MAX_VALUE comes back as the positive 1661992959, verified with the declared sign-check edit). The gold's @param assigns only the empty check to its caller, and hop 4 does it, so no hop doc puts the range check on a caller. Hop 3 decimal compare also leaves 0x80000000, #FFFFFFFF and 020000000000 wrapping, which breaks hop 3's and the facade's @throws. The declared one-line compensating edits fail the trigger (cases 18 and 5). (d) The names are neutral, there are no comments in any body, and the added lines contain no fault vocabulary. The lie (digits read last-to-first and multiplied by powers of the radix) is procedural and false: the code reads first to last with Horner accumulation. It does not mention range, overflow or any hop. (e) The gold is five calls below the facade. The hops are in five different existing classes (StrBuilder, StringUtils, SystemUtils, FastDateFormat, DateUtils). The facade is the original null guard plus one delegating call, with one added sentence. The gold's javadoc is silent on the range check. The trigger is an existing test and is the only new failure.
